identities.hessian: Hess log pi=diag(Hess log mu,Hess log nu)
identities.score: grad log pi=(grad log mu, grad log nu)

scope: These pointwise identities cover the arbitrary product coupling specialization in Lemma 1/Corollary 3; exact unequal Gaussian marginals are only numerical corroboration.
universal_variables: all positive C2 marginal densities mu(x), nu(y)
